reviews.text: I contacted Adelise about eight months ago for my dog ​​Linka, who is very sensitive and has a high frequency of attention. She had developed, among other things, reactivity towards other dogs. On top of everything else, we had become disconnected due to some difficult periods in my personal life. I greatly appreciated Adelise's approach, which goes far beyond simply making a dog obey. She takes a personalized approach to understanding each dog and therefore provides tailored solutions. First and foremost, I was able to re-establish a genuine connection with my dog, which I believe is essential for managing a dog's reactivity. All the exercises, the way we structured our walks, and the gradual approach all contributed to initiating real changes in Linka, and I can attest to this after almost nine months. Of course, everything isn't perfect yet, but I've regained my confidence, my desire to believe, and a dog who can lie down on her own for a few minutes during walks, and whose encounters with other dogs are less emotionally charged. A huge thank you!
Adelise is a top-notch behaviorist 🌟, both for our furry friends and for supporting us humans. She's a kind and highly competent person who will help you understand your dog 🐶 …

Is incapable of handling sensitive situations.

During one encounter, this person was walking eight dogs off-leash, several of them without collars.
One of the females behaved roughly with my three-month-old puppy, and this person was completely overwhelmed. There was no recall and her reaction was extremely weak despite my puppy's whining and attempts to escape. She had to start running...
Then she had the nerve to try and explain things to me because of her "qualifications," without even having the courage to introduce herself.

I wholeheartedly recommend Adelise! She's kind, professional, attentive, and has genuine experience and knowledge of canine behavior. Adelise guided me through the adoption of a shelter dog, which went very smoothly thanks to her (and her wonderful colleagues at the Clebs Club!). I also recommend her dog walking services, which allow dogs to expend energy and socialize while reinforcing their training.

Adelise has been looking after Oreo, our cocker spaniel, for several walks now, and I highly recommend her. Every time, everything goes perfectly: he adores her, and they bond instantly. The walks tire him out enormously, which makes a real difference to his energy levels, and he's constantly discovering new things. The dog groups are great and well-managed. Adelise is reliable and caring; you can tell Oreo is in good hands. Thank you for everything!

Adelise is wonderful with your babies! Simba is happy after every walk; he's content and, above all, exhausted! He knows that every Tuesday he goes for a walk! It's a date he wouldn't miss for the world.

She is kind, attentive, and, most importantly, listens to your babies. I have complete confidence in her! I recommend her 100%.

I've been entrusting my dog ​​Rustine to Adelise for wonderful group walks for a few months now. Rustine always sees her with great joy. I have complete confidence in Adelise. She is competent, reliable, and gentle. She sees the uniqueness in each dog and adapts to our furry friends with finesse. A big thank you!

We are very lucky to be able to regularly entrust our Vega, who is not always comfortable outdoors and is very sensitive, to Adelise for nature walks with other dogs! As Adelise is also a trainer, the walks she offers allow Vega to progress a lot and to experience great moments in a group and to socialize, with attentive and caring support.
Very good, a very serious and reliable person... My dog ​​is delighted to see Adelise arrive in her white van... I recommend her.

Adelise is very professional and attentive.
I recommend her without hesitation.

I contacted Adelise for help with Paige, a 7-year-old Australian Shepherd who is reactive to both people and other dogs. With great gentleness and unwavering good humor, Adelise helped us establish a calming routine for Paige, adapt my environment, and better understand interactions between people and other dogs. The progress was immediate, which was such a relief! Adelise also helped us connect with a network of other human-dog pairs, try new canine activities (tracking), and discover fantastic spots for nature walks. I highly recommend her!

Our dog, Toffee, is a regular at the group walks organized by Adelise! He always comes back happy, so much so that he regularly watches for the Canimobile in the street. We feel confident with Adelise. She takes the time to get to know all the dogs to create harmonious groups, adapts the schedule according to the weather, and suggests a variety of locations!
At the end of each walk, we receive a detailed report on both the group dynamics and our dog—and lots of photos!!!

In short, I highly recommend it! 👍

A real disappointment. We do not recommend this service for families. We contacted Adelise for dog walks, and she initially asked for a €150 assessment followed by three individual sessions (€150 + 3 sessions of €55 each). She involved the children in the process (via a WhatsApp group) only to abruptly end the walks after two months (via email) due to a phone call issue upon our dog's return (pressing the intercom or having my husband call would have been too complicated). Neither the children nor we understood this abruptness. We do not recommend her.
Super, patient and very good at explaining things, Adeline helped me work with my Shiba, gave me a lot of very useful information to better understand my dog ​​and improve our relationship 👍 …

It's a real pleasure to exchange ideas and work with Adelise. I had an assessment done before the dog arrived and 10 training sessions. It's a real advantage to have the right tools to get off to a great start with your best four-legged friend.

We contacted Adelise for help with our young Beauceron's tendency to pull on the leash. Adelise is skilled at analyzing and understanding our dog's behavior, providing a thorough assessment and excellent advice. We greatly appreciate her training sessions and walks.

Adelise is a fantastic dog behaviorist and walker. She's very attentive to dogs' needs and has managed to put our little Ankara at ease on walks. She's now thrilled to go for walks, and we always get a very clear and concise debriefing. You can leave your dog with her with complete confidence.

Adelise was recommended to me by another dog trainer who was helping me through a difficult post-adoption period with my first dog, Rouky—an Australian Shepherd who struggled in the city and was hesitant, even fearful, around other dogs. Meeting Adelise, her dog Lupa, and the other dogs they take on wonderful nature walks changed everything for Rouky! He gained confidence, learned to interact more calmly with other dogs, and even started to accept stillness (which was previously impossible). His recall improved tenfold! And for me, Adelise showed me how important and beneficial gentleness is, both for my dog ​​and for me, and for our human-canine relationship. Thank you, Adelise!

Adelise is a wonderful behaviorist and dog walker. She worked with our rescue dog who has extreme anxiety and was always attentive, patient, and gentle with her. She took our dog hiking in beautiful places and worked with her to make her comfortable around other dogs. We highly recommend Adelise!

Adelise is a fantastic dog trainer! Kind, gentle, and a great teacher, she's always available and has responded very quickly to any questions or issues we've had with our little Vanna. What's more, she's calm, collected, and funny 😁. Vanna adores her (she can't compete with her Saucifl...!) and so do we. …

Adelise is a fantastic trainer and behaviorist! She's patient, observant, and a great listener, offering excellent advice. A true professional!
Our dog Muf, adopted after a traumatic experience, is extremely anxious and doesn't trust people at first, but Adelise, with her positive approach, has managed to create a special bond with her, and our dog is so happy to see her for walks with other dogs.

I have complete confidence in Adelise and her expertise. She always gives us very clear and personalized feedback on our dog's behavior and also shares anecdotes and photos from walks that delight us.
She's exactly the approachable and caring trainer I was looking for for Muf. She organizes walking groups based on personalities and ensures the group size is always reasonable so she can be available and focused on our furry friends.

She also has a fantastic, ultra-secure dog van. I recommend Adelise 100%!

PS: And she's super nice too!

I had the pleasure of welcoming Adelise for observation internships with me on several occasions throughout her training. Adelise is not only passionate but also extremely competent.

She is also a dedicated and caring person, and it's a pleasure to spend time with her (a significant advantage when starting a training program!).
I had the opportunity to accompany her on her sessions and walks, and I highly recommend her services for her professionalism, expertise, and positive attitude!
And what's more, she has a fantastic van with excellent, secure transport crates!

When I fulfilled my dream of having a little puppy in my life, Jenna, I was incredibly stressed and anxious. A tiny, two-month-old living being that I had to care for, understand her needs, and with whom I had to build a strong bond.

Adelise helped me create this bond by helping me better understand my dog, why she did what she did, why she reacted the way she did, and how to ensure her well-being.

I was able to experience individual training sessions with Adelise (at home and in town), and the dog-walking service for a few months where Adelise picks up the dogs and takes a small group (so cool!) out to let them run around and have fun with their friends in the countryside. And more recently, the educational walks! These walks for dogs and their humans help to better understand canine interactions, share quality time with your dog, and work on socialization. It's truly fascinating and a wonderful experience.

Adelise is incredibly approachable and proactive. Whenever I had questions or new situations to discuss, she always responded quickly with clear and reassuring suggestions.

I wholeheartedly recommend Les Canines (100%, if not more), because it's also thanks to her that my dog ​​Jenna and I are living our beautiful love story.

(Jenna recommends her too, since she howls with joy when she sees Adelise!)
Adelise is a trustworthy professional. She works with gentleness and patience, and her advice is excellent. Thank you for everything.

Adelise is as motivated as she is motivating! Extremely attentive, competent, observant, and insightful. No worries, she'll adapt to any situation! Special mention goes to her clear and detailed reports, which ensure nothing is forgotten so you can work on your own. Special mention also goes to her kindness and energy. And a special mention to her countless ideas!! In short, I truly loved the time we spent together, the three of us, and of course, Vecchio too!

Thank you for everything 🙏🏼🤗

Adelise has been walking my dog ​​since the beginning of the year. She offers a top-notch service because her walks are educational: the dog gets exercise and training! My dog ​​LOVES walking with her: he comes back fulfilled and happy (and snores for a good few hours afterward). Even better, I think the price is very reasonable. Thanks again!

Adelise has been working with us and our puppy, Ziggy, since she was 5 months old. Ziggy is a very alert, rather anxious sheepdog. From our very first meeting, Adelise listened attentively and quickly understood our dog's behavior. During the sessions (which varied greatly; at home, in the city, and in nature), she gave us numerous tips for managing her emotions. The session reports are very detailed, with practical exercises that are easy to implement. Ziggy is much calmer, and so are we! Thank you so much, Adelise, for your superb work!

A fantastic and attentive trainer who takes the time to get to know your dog in order to offer personalized training. Adelise is very respectful of our dog and always gives great advice, ever since our dog was a puppy. I highly recommend Adelise!

We met Adelise after adopting our 2-year-old dog from a shelter in Romania. She immediately reassured us and gave us excellent advice. Highly dedicated and a great teacher, I highly recommend her services!

Adelise gives us lots of great advice for training our young boxer. Sessions at home, in the streets of Marseille, in the forest—the settings are varied and adaptable to our needs.
Vigor, for example, walks much better on sidewalks and pulls much less on his leash. Thank you, Adelise, and see you soon for the next installment!
Adelise shared her expertise and knowledge to help us better understand our little dog! Beyond a thorough analysis, she provided us with the necessary tools to confidently grow alongside him!

Adelise is an exceptional professional, equally attentive to humans and dogs. Her method, based on kindness, fully respects the needs of each animal and their humans. I highly recommend her services to build a beautiful relationship with your four-legged companion ❤️

Absolutely the best!!! I have complete confidence in Adelise when I entrust her with my little darling! The nature walks are incredibly convenient; Adelise takes care of transportation and sends photos, videos, and detailed reports of the outings—it's truly wonderful! And finally, it's reassuring to be dealing with a competent professional. She adapted to my dog's needs and specific requirements, taking the time to get to know her well. A huge thank you! 🙂

Adelise's encounter with my puppy and her guidance allowed me to gain the serenity I needed: a kind and inspiring approach. The results were more than satisfactory. I sincerely thank Adelise for her expertise and highly recommend her.

Adelise offers a very attentive approach to both the dog and its owners. She reassured us about our doubts and advised us on exercises to help our puppy thrive. We also benefit from her dog walking service when we're unavailable to walk our four-legged friend ourselves. You can go ahead with complete confidence!
Thank you so much, Adelise, for your advice! Fantastic support, very professional and incredibly kind 🙏🏼 Best of luck with this promising business launch!! …
Adeline is a very good listener, whether it's with people or animals. She will help you better understand your dog and resolve your issues.
Adelise combines competence, calmness, and teaching skills. A true breath of fresh air for dog training! I highly recommend her without hesitation!

Adelise is a dog lover and an exceptional advisor! She's attentive, a good listener, thorough, and will undoubtedly help you better understand our four-legged friends 🐾
Personally, she gave me invaluable advice when I adopted my dog, who was already a year and a half old when he arrived home. It allowed us to welcome him calmly, find our balance, and even work on his recall so we could fully enjoy our walks together! I wholeheartedly recommend contacting Adelise to better understand your dog and feel even more comfortable in your relationship 🐶

If you're looking for someone overflowing with love for dogs and who knows how to care for them, look no further, you've found her!

I've had the pleasure of speaking with Adelise several times in recent months. She has always given excellent advice and has an approach that places the needs of both dog and human at the heart of building the most fulfilling relationship possible for both.

Adelise is also very friendly, which makes communication truly smooth and enjoyable, and very thorough in her work, which inspires confidence when entrusting her with our four-legged companions.
Don't hesitate to contact her; you won't be disappointed! :)
